entities.summary: The Peace of Zsitvatorok was a peace treaty which ended the 13-year Long Turkish War between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg monarchy on 11 November 1606. The treaty was part of a system of peace treaties which put an end to the anti-Habsburg uprising of Stephen Bocskai (1604–1606). The treaty was negotiated between 24 October and 11 November 1606 ad Situa Torock, at the former mouth of the Žitava River, which flows into the Danube in Royal Hungary. This location would later become the small settlement of Žitavská Tôňa, a part of the municipality of Radvaň nad Dunajom.
